style.styleTitle: Personalised Me To You Tatty Bear Christmas Bauble by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: Christmas wishes from the Me To You Tatty Bear. Personalise this cosy Christmas bauble with their name and a special message from you on the reverse. All personalisation is case sensitive and will appear as entered. Please refrain from using all capital letters as this will make the font difficult to read. The ceramic bauble comes supplied with a ribbon ready to hang straight onto the tree. Dimensions – 6cm x 6cm.
